name: @dreamteamer/meeting-docs
description: The documents around a meeting, for a dreamteamer workspace — a prep before, a summary after, a critique on the transcript, and the tasks it produces.

dreamteamer.title: Meeting docs
dreamteamer.description: The three documents a call produces and the pipeline that writes them: the ten-minute `meeting-preps` read before walking in (`preparing-for-meetings`, `/prepare-for-meeting`, `/create-meeting`), the neutral `meeting-summaries` record of what was said (`/summarize-meeting`), and the `meeting-analyses` critique built on the raw transcript and never on the summary (`analyzing-meetings`, `/analyze-meetings`) — plus `/extract-tasks-from-meetings`, which turns a summary into `tasks`, and `/process-new-meetings`, which sequences the whole chain from sync to critique. Each record points at its `meetings` record and stamps `prep`, `summary` and `analyses` onto it; summarise, extract and analyse are gated on a transcribed recording, which is why this module depends on `recordings`. Depends on `meetings`, `recordings`, `tasks`, `contacts` and `companies`.
